versions.localizedDescription:
YouTube Plus v6.0

YouTube Plus Player
- New built-in player for downloaded videos and for streaming videos straight from YouTube without downloading
- Queue, video quality selection, subtitles, audio tracks, ambient mode, SponsorBlock, sleep timer, Discord RPC, gestures, mini player, background playback, Picture-in-Picture and more
- Remembers playback progress and resumes where you left off
- Option to open videos in the YouTube Plus player instead of YouTube's

Downloads
- New Downloads tab with shared, separate and private sections
- Select multiple files and act on them at once
- Resume interrupted downloads
- Download whole playlists
- Download later action in the download menu
- Edit metadata before and after downloading
- Convert videos and songs before downloading or any time later
- Downloads keep running in the background
- Download sheet remembers the last selected post-download action and encoding preset
- Improved downloader engine with support for new YouTube versions

Parental control
- Passcode for YouTube and YouTube Plus settings, account switching and the tab bar menu
- Restricted mode
- External link blocking
- Watch history
- Daily limit and allowed hours
- Channel blocklist and allowlist

YouTube Player
- Improved speed controls in the player overlay
- Inverted fullscreen option in the player overlay
- Loop button in the player overlay
- Rearrange the tweak's buttons in the player overlay
- Option to disable Picture-in-Picture
- Added "Don't offer SharePlay" option
- Option to keep feed videos muted when pressing the volume buttons
- Sleep timer can stop playback after a chosen chapter
- Improved selection of quality, subtitles and audio tracks
- Set several preferred languages for audio tracks and subtitles
- Option to enable captions when the preferred audio track isn't available
- More options to hide buttons under the player and in the context menu
- Improved playback fix mechanism
- Fixed YouTube Premium downloads on sideloaded installs (requires a YouTube Premium subscription)

Feed & Shorts
- Hide sponsored videos in profiles, new Playables and other feed elements (see the Feed section)
- Hide the new ads in Shorts
- Improved hiding of unwanted elements
- Fixed Shorts auto-skip on newer versions

Tab bar
- Add playlists as tabs
- Improved tab editor, tabs can now be edited offline
- The Downloads tab no longer reappears on every launch

SponsorBlock
- Submit segments, vote on existing ones and change their categories
- View all sponsor segments from the SponsorBlock menu in the player overlay

Create fancy videos with other unique features: auto captions, text-to-speech, motion tracking, and background removal. Show your personality and go viral on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook!

Basic video editing

• Animate video clips with incredible zoom in/out effects.
• Highlight the best moments with the freeze feature.
• Explore transition options with awesome effects on and between clips.

Advanced video editor
• Keyframe video animation is available for all settings.
• Edit videos to create smooth slow-motion with the optical flow feature and speed curve tool.
• Use the chroma key to remove specific colors from videos.
• Easy to arrange and preview clips on multi-track timeline.
• The stabilizing feature keeps video footage steady.

Intelligent features
• Auto captions: automate speech recognition and subtitles in videos.
• Text-to-speech: apply text-to-speech in multiple languages and voices.
• Background removal: automatically remove backgrounds.

Text & Stickers
• Add text to videos with different fonts and styles, choose unique text templates. Fonts can be imported locally.

Trending Effects & Filters

• Add movie-style video filters or adjust video brightness, contrast, etc.

Music & Sound Effects
• Add millions of music clips and sound effects to videos.
• Extract audio, clips, and recordings from videos.

Easy to Share
• Custom video export resolution, HD video editor supports 4K 60fps exports and smart HDR.
• Adjust the format and share with your friends on social media platforms.

• Games that ask for OpenGL ES 3.1 don't fall over on launch

• Minecraft's huge libraries load
• Python-for-Android games convert their bundled libraries too
• Games that try to JIT their own code (LuaJIT, PCRE2) fall back the way they do on a phone, instead of needing Husk's JIT.

• Starting full Android makes you wait five seconds on the warning. It's still the emulator. Don't use it for games
• Compatibility reports wait if the site is down, then send
• Certificate passwords (including empty ones) actually work
• Lots of fixes under Play without JIT so Unity and C++ games don't die on the first exception

• Some games still need JIT (ones that generate code at runtime, including a few with their own anti-tamper)
• Hollow Knight and Cuphead still have no sound
• Some games (Disco Elysium, Muse Dash) don't take touch input
• 32-bit only apps don't run
